checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly flagged official_boundary=false and provisional_rough; all dependent metrics require recalculation after official data.
Three key areas remain explicit provisional constraints and retain announcement area metadata.
Seven concept bands are an exact partition of the provisional site geometry in EPSG:4548.
Known spatial metrics are derived from submitted geometry; unavailable controls remain unknown with reasons.
Narrative, five figures, report HTML, visual HTML, A3 booklet and A0 boards have English counterparts.
Static offline HTML contains no scripts, remote assets, forms or embeds.
Every required chapter contains claim-adjacent evidence markers linked to structured files.
Case material is paraphrased; no external media is reproduced; submission identity and licence are declared.
